pages.text: Five herbs are the physician's stock. Each grows wild in its own country, and the herb itself can be planted again on farmland or plain dirt.$(br2)$(l)Garlic$(): plains.$(br)$(l)Rue$(): savanna.$(br)$(l)Sage$(): mountains.$(br)$(l)Wormwood$(): swamps.$(br)$(l)Rosemary$(): forests.
Many remedies want $(l)dried$() herbs. Hang fresh ones on a $(l)Drying Rack$() (up to four) and take them down a minute later.
